mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.real_name AS name, sex as gender, age, phone, doc_id AS doctorId, d.real_name AS realName FROM sys_patient as p left join sys_doctor as d on p.doc_id = d.id WHERE p.id = #{patientId}

SELECT a.id, a.visit_date AS date, a.time_slot AS timeSlot, d.real_name AS realName, a.status FROM sys_appointment a LEFT JOIN sys_doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.id WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} AND a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY a.visit_date DESC

SELECT r.id, r.patient_id AS patientId, r.doctor_id AS doctorId, r.doctor_name AS realName, r.diagnosis, r.prescription, r.create_time AS createTime, r.appointment_id AS appointmentId, r.update_time FROM sys_medical_record r WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_appointment SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{appointmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_medical_record (appointment_id, diagnosis, prescription, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{diagnosis}, #{prescription}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_medical_record WHERE appointment_id IN (SELECT id FROM sys_appointment WHERE patient_id = #{patientId})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_patient WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT patient_id FROM sys_appointment WHERE id = #{appointmentId}
SELECT real_name FROM sys_patient WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT doctor_id AS doctorId, patient_id AS patientId FROM sys_appointment WHERE id = #{id}
